payload.entry: LAND AUDIT: reviewed all four phase scopes/notes and both plans with inherited final DECISIONS. Reviewed epic commits b175b63758, 8f982c8ae9, f7eb80c7a8, 7da649b562, c9a65d1a58 and post-start commits through c9a65d1a58; inspected Rust payload/lifecycle/prepared-reservation/atomic-join contracts at 2a625131, confirmed current core pin 17e79c8 contains that commit. Later 86bec79ca4 repaired the reported completion snapshot and kind coverage; both now pass. Existing staging/contracts/activation plus completion and exact suite-gate test: 53 passed. Found remaining epic defects with isolated local probes: (1) real stage_monitor promotes a bare acme to acme--0, but _adopt_monitor/_runner_ctx_from_metadata rejects the persisted name against the original runner name; (2) real monitor adopter returns monitored with saved_chat_paths=[], and real finalize_loop then saves response empty and calls persist_agent_delta_best_effort zero times even with result.response_text=REAL RESPONSE; this skips exact starter continuation ancestry; (3) staging a request with checkpoint_ref and checkpoint_document preserves only the reference, and reconstructed request.checkpoint_document is None. Existing activation tests stub staging/adoption and do not exercise these boundaries; ordering test substitutes finalizer_settlement_refusal on its successful branch. Preparing one medium tale for these bounded repairs, stronger integrated acceptance, and same-turn closeout of this epic and parent phase sase-1pj.5. Outer crash recovery/carry hardening remain sase-1pj.6/.7, not new tasks. Symbol cleanup is being completed in this landing turn so upstream whitelist rows will not require the tale coder to wait for its own commit.

Additional reproduction for the identity repair: reserve_detached_run(check, agent=acme) followed by real stage_monitor(..., join_run_id=RUN) for a bare starter promotes its metadata to acme--0, then refuses staged join reservation with agent_mismatch. The original ToolRun starter remains acme. The repair tale includes preservation of original reserved-run ownership while using the verified promoted identity for transcripts. No Rust join-ownership weakening is warranted.

LAND CLEANUP: Removed all four sase-1pj.5.1 epic-symbol entries from the local Justfile, privatized the monitor result types and in-file payload loader, and deleted the unused prepared-reservation loader (tests use the existing store reader). just fix and just symvision passed; the two changed test modules passed 34 tests after cleanup, and the prepared-bridge/host-completion suites passed 16 tests. epic-symbols now lists only origin/master rows; this lander commit retires them before the repair tale so its same-turn closeout will not depend on its own future commit. The governed just check is still running (ToolRun 811e6a0b4501e7f85e6a30855f17afe0): all format/lint/validation stages passed; Justfile broadening selected the full nonvisual test lane, currently waiting for worker tokens. No check-full was invoked. The validated medium tale also corrects the activation skill-source sentence that claims staged monitors never synthesize carry: the host controller does synthesize eligible unprepared carry when there is no explicit declaration. It preserves explicit commit-before-CI-wait and prepared commit-on-green, with no global skill deployment in the coding turn.

LAND VERIFICATION COMPLETE: Governed just check (ToolRun 811e6a0b4501e7f85e6a30855f17afe0) exited 0 after all format/lint/validation stages and the internally broadened full nonvisual test lane passed. No just check-full was run. The final cleanup diff is limited to Justfile, the two monitor/prepared modules, and their two test modules; diff --check is clean and the linked core checkout is unchanged. Refreshed origin/master through deb8bb60b6 and reviewed 3f9fe9c107 (CLI assertion stabilization), d69741b370 (stopped-agent Context presentation), and deb8bb60b6 (release wheel matching); none creates another monitor-staging integration requirement. The medium remaining-work tale passed the explain/edit/revalidate loop with zero warnings and includes the three reproduced defects, real finalizer acceptance coverage, narrow monitor skill wording correction, all prior follow-up dispositions, and concrete same-turn closeout of this epic plus parent phase sase-1pj.5 only. This epic and its linked plan remain open until that work is complete; submitting the tale now.

LANDED (final lander, resumed after the repair tale's blocked close). VERIFIED: all four phases closed; every phase note addressed. Epic commits b175b63758 (Rust staged payload/liveness/self-wait/atomic join + prepared-reservation contracts, core pin), 8f982c8ae9 (stage/launch split, reserved ToolRuns, persisted reconstruction, cleanup), f7eb80c7a8 (prepared intents reserved-not-bound, bind at spawn, early-settled join consumption), 7da649b562 + c9a65d1a58 (flag-on in-agent starts stage; post-finalizer monitor adopter; held/discard cleanup releases ToolRun/join/prepared reservations), and repair tale feae9c8777 (plan 202610/monitor_staging_landing_repairs.md). Re-read current source after later splits 0e8ebf3ce1/211158db70: repairs survive in start_stage_persist/start_stage_adopt/staged_adopters. (1) Promotion: _runner_ctx_from_monitor_metadata accepts only the exact root promotion (acme->acme--0 / plan suffix, same session base/workflow/role) and refuses foreign starters before launch; -J reserves with the original starter (LaneStart.join_starter_agent), Rust join guard unweakened. (2) Real response + exact continuation: capture_monitor_handoff saves the real provider response plus monitor details, appends saved_chat_paths, requires checkpoint + starter delta (status completed) before launch, and binds monitor parent_node_ids to that exact starter node; finalize_loop keeps done.response_path on that chat with one delta. (3) Authored checkpoint canonicalized and frozen under the member's continuation/checkpoints at stage; missing/corrupt/unsafe refs refuse at adoption. Ordering: test_staged_monitor_waits_for_real_finalizer_controller (both branches) and test_adoption_waits_for_finalizer_settlement; prepared green/red via test_finalizers_prepared_bridge; flag-off/non-agent immediate path preserved. Targeted run: 586 passed (monitor stage/adopt/cleanup/prepared/activation, staged contracts, prepared bridge, staged acceptance matrix, feature flags, completion). INTEGRATION: reviewed all commits after feae9c8777 (sase-1q4 wait-target/fork-wait work, start_stage and test splits, docs refresh 2a75018b01). Fixed epic-caused drift that docs refresh flagged: sase monitor start --help still described kill-only handoffs (now describes the staged flag-on path; regenerated docs/reference/cli/monitor.md), and the staged_handoffs flag description named plans only though it now gates plan/question/pipe/gate/monitor handoffs (registry + regenerated sase.schema.json and config/integrations.md). Declined: core-floor wait-target API pin gap noted in 2a75018b01 belongs to sase-1q4, not this epic. CHECKS: sase tool run check c9e76124c5e49cb90956fe00f4815d43 succeeded (all fmt/lint incl. symvision, mypy, feature flags, docs build, scoped tests). No check-full run. epic-symbols: none.
